name: How We Should Live Our Lives
overview: Scripture calls believers to live lives fully devoted to God, trusting Him wholeheartedly rather than relying on their own understanding (Proverbs 3:5). This life is marked by doing what is just, loving mercy, and walking humbly with God (Micah 6:8), offering ourselves as living sacrifices in response to His mercy (Romans 12:1). The Christian life is characterized by Christ living within us, motivating us to live by faith and reflect His love (Galatians 2:20), speaking words that build others up (Ephesians 4:29), and walking worthy of the Lord by bearing fruit and growing in the knowledge of God (Colossians 1:10).
